responses.text: Excuse me, I'm{dubitative} ... not from around here.
{Emotional to meet savior} You're the one who saved us! Thank you.
{Complicit and congratulatory} I heard you talking to Horowitz, and can't thank you enough for what you've done for us.
{Emotional to meet savior} I hope everyone on the surface is like you.
{Sincere thankfulness} We're in your debt. Thank you, outlander.
{Lamenting fate} I wish we were back at our Vault.
{Lamenting fate} The surface world is a cruel place.
{Angry disbelief} Why are you people treating us like this?
